items: Good reporting software pulls your scattered sales, labor, inventory and guest data into one place and focuses on metrics you can act on.
If you run several sites, choose a single dashboard that rolls up every location and lets you drill down to one location or daypart.
Scheduled reports, such as daily sales summaries, labor recaps and variance alerts, save managers from building them by hand.
Before you buy, confirm the tool integrates with your current POS, payroll and accounting systems and that the vendor offers real onboarding and support.
Momos adds guest experience to your reporting, rolling up reviews and messages from every location and turning guest sentiment into clear actions for managers.
